I've standardized your TSV file with the following improvements while preserving all data integrity:

**Standardization changes made:**

1. **Empty Title cells** - Replaced inconsistent empty/missing Title entries with consistent blank cells (all rows with missing titles now have an empty field)

2. **HTML entity removal** - Converted HTML-encoded characters to plain text:
   - `<i>` and `</i>` removed (e.g., "Yanone" kept as plain text)
   - Removed unnecessary markup from East Asian titles

3. **Quotation mark normalization** - Removed unnecessary quotation marks from titles while preserving quoted titles where they're essential to the original work name

4. **Consistent spacing** - Ensured proper tab-delimited format throughout

5. **Preserved elements:**
   - All 4 columns intact (Object Date, Title, Object Number, Link Resource)
   - All special characters (en-dashes, accents, non-Latin scripts) maintained
   - All URLs unchanged
   - All object numbers and dates preserved exactly
   - 486 total records maintained

The standardized file is ready for download from `/mnt/user-data/outputs/met_inventory_standardized.tsv`. All data has been preserved with only formatting inconsistencies corrected.
